name: tag_tv
parts: tag_first: U64, tag count + 1 entries: per tag code c the number of tv_order positions whose row's tag code is below c
tv_version: U64, one per tv_order position: the version code of the row at that position

layout.summary: the 28 parts of storage tag unchanged, then tag_first (per tag code, its first tv_order position) and tv_version (the version code at each tv_order position): a (tag, version) -> row index over tag's own keys.
layout.units: positions: tv_order positions; codes: tag's own tag / version dictionary positions; rows: canonical tag rows
